name: tr_jv
caption:
IF JONAS VALANČIŪNAS HAD A POKÉMON TEAM, HERE'S WHO WE'D SEND OUT 🎮🏀

🐳 Wailmer: bounces like a ball, eats a ton of food a day. Drafted 5th in 2011, All-Rookie second team
🐦 Pelipper: scoops up prey in one gulp. Set our playoff rebound record with 18 in 2014, then broke it with 19 in 2016
🪨 Golem: even dynamite can't harm it. 7 blocks against Memphis, a career best
💎 Boldore: only evolves in a trade. February 2019: traded to Memphis for Marc Gasol. That June, we were champions
🧭 Onix: a magnet in its brain, so it never loses its way. After 14 NBA seasons, back home in Lithuania with Žalgiris
🐋 Wailord: the biggest of all. 21 points and 21 rebounds in Game 1 vs Cleveland in 2018, the best playoff double-double in our history

That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? 👇

Monster sprites: PMD Sprite Collab (sprites.pmdcollab.org), CC BY-NC 4.0

beats.vo: If Jonas Valanciunas had a Pokemon team, here's what we'd be running.
beats.dlg: IF VALANCIUNAS HAD A TEAM|OF MONSTERS...

beats.vo: First up, Wailmer. It bounces around like a ball and eats a ton of food a day. We took Jonas fifth in twenty eleven. As a rookie: All-Rookie second team.
beats.dlg: IT BOUNCES LIKE A BALL.|PICK 5, THEN ALL-ROOKIE

beats.vo: Pelipper. It scoops up its prey with its huge bill, everything in one gulp. Jonas set our playoff rebound record with eighteen. Then he broke his own record with nineteen.
beats.dlg: IT SCOOPS UP EVERYTHING.|PLAYOFF RECORD: 19 BOARDS

beats.vo: Golem. Even dynamite can't harm its boulder-like body. Against Memphis in twenty sixteen, Jonas blocked seven shots. A career best.
beats.dlg: DYNAMITE CAN'T HURT IT.|7 BLOCKS VS MEMPHIS

beats.vo: Boldore. It only evolves when it gets traded. February twenty nineteen: Jonas went to Memphis for Marc Gasol. That June, we were champions.
beats.dlg: TRADE IT AND IT EVOLVES.|2019: TRADED FOR GASOL

beats.vo: Onix. There's a magnet in its brain, so it never loses its way. After fourteen NBA seasons, Jonas went back home to Lithuania, to Zalgiris.
beats.dlg: IT NEVER LOSES ITS WAY.|14 NBA YEARS, THEN HOME

beats.vo: And the ace. Wailord. The biggest of all Pokemon. Game one against Cleveland: twenty-one points and twenty-one rebounds. The best playoff double-double in our history.
beats.dlg: THE BIGGEST OF THEM ALL.|21 PTS + 21 REB VS CLE

beats.vo: That's a party we'd take into any building. Which one would you swap in? Comment below.
beats.dlg: A PARTY WE'D TAKE INTO|ANY BUILDING. WHO'S IN?

facts.claim: Valanciunas: drafted fifth overall (No. 5 pick) by Toronto in the 2011 NBA draft, signed with the Raptors 18 July 2012; NBA All-Rookie Second Team (2013); 2014 playoffs game 1 vs Brooklyn 17 points and 18 rebounds, a franchise record for rebounds in a playoff game; 2016 playoffs game 1 vs Indiana set a franchise playoff record with 19 rebounds, surpassing his own mark; career-best 7 blocks vs Memphis (2016); 7 February 2019 traded to Memphis for Marc Gasol; in game 1 of the 2018 second round vs Cleveland 21 points and 21 rebounds, the best playoff double-double in franchise history; 15 July 2026 ended his 14-year NBA career and signed with Zalgiris in Lithuania
Gasol traded to Toronto for Valanciunas on February 7, 2019 and won an NBA championship with the Raptors in 2019

Wailmer: 'It eats one ton of food every day' and bounces like a ball; Pelipper scoops up prey and swallows everything in one gulp; Golem: 'Even dynamite can't harm its hard, boulder-like body'; Onix: magnet in its brain prevents it from losing direction; Wailord: 'The biggest of all Pokemon' (PokeAPI species flavor text)
Boldore evolves into Gigalith by trade (PokeAPI evolution chain)
